Adding some troubleshooting detail from the infra side. I pulled the onboarding service logs for greenbridge.com and saw repeated 302 -> /verify-org?claim=... with a relayState that has the org string URL-encoded differently than what our normalizer expects. Short version: the verify step is repeatedly re-posting to itself because the normalized org identifier doesn't match the claim in the session cookie.

What I tried:
- Replicated locally using the same payload Liam attached.
- Confirmed the claim contains an extra punctuation character for 'Greenbridge, LLC' in the legal_name field. That extra comma triggers our normalization pipeline to produce `greenbridge-llc` vs `greenbridgellc` which then fails the prefix match check in the verify handler.

Temporary mitigation we can roll immediately: add an alias mapping for that exact incoming claim to the canonical org id so the verify handler completes. I created a Jira ticket to track the change and rollback: SUP-2128. Logs excerpt attached.

Workaround for your AP team until we flip the alias: try signing in with the invite link in an incognito window but after clearing cookies ensure the invite link is the last navigation (some browsers cache the redirected claim). Not ideal — engineering is optimizing the handler ASAP.

Attachments: auth-log-excerpt.txt (text/plain)

Ben
